Off until you connect an account. Then the songs you play (title, artist, album, length and when) go from this phone to the services you connect. It\'s the only thing Polyphony sends anywhere but your own server.
If your server already scrobbles to the same account (Navidrome: Personal; continuo: Play now songs), connect it in one place only, or plays count twice.
